title: Canonical interchange of two ideal-power quotients
statement: Let X be a scheme, I and K quasi-coherent ideal sheaves, and H an O_X-module. Use the positive-level cokernel quotients and completion diagrams of [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. There exists an isomorphism θ of doubly indexed diagrams with θ_{e,n} : (H/K^(e+1)H)/I^(n+1) ≅ (H/I^(n+1)H)/K^(e+1), natural in e,n≥0. Its composite with the two quotient projections from H in the first order equals the composite projection in the second order.

proof.text: Reuse the proved idealModuleProduct_quotient_comp_zero_iff from CoherentFormalModule through a proof-only import all. It identifies vanishing on a quotient ideal product with vanishing after the original epimorphic quotient projection. Its existing proof uses image factorization, multiplication naturality, and preservation of epimorphisms by tensoring.

Construct quotientSwapMap I K H e n by two successive cokernel.desc factorizations of the projection H → H/I^n H → (H/I^n H)/K^e. The descent equivalence proves the two required vanishing conditions. Two applications of cokernel.π_desc give quotientSwapMap_projection, identifying its composite with the two quotient projections with the projection in the opposite order. This construction is valid at all nonnegative exponents.

Construct quotientSwapIso with forward map quotientSwapMap I K H e n and inverse quotientSwapMap K I H n e. Precompose each inverse-law equation with the two epimorphic quotient projections and use quotientSwapMap_projection in both orders to identify both composites with the identity.

At positive indices e+1,n+1, use NatIso.ofComponents twice to assemble quotientSwapIso into the required doubly indexed diagram isomorphism. In each index naturality equation, cancel both quotient projections, unfold quotientSwapMap and formalModuleQuotientMap, and simplify using Mathlib cokernel.π_desc, cokernel.π_desc_assoc and associativity. These give equality for every index morphism. The component projection equation is exactly the required displayed identity.

proof_origin.note: Existing universal-property route implemented and compiled in Lean by D3. Repair reuses the private descent theorem of CoherentFormalModule with import all, removes all four duplicate helpers, and uses Mathlib cokernel equations directly for naturality. No new proof dependency or hole.

theorem grothendieckDevissage_secondAdicSystem_comparison
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (I K : X.IdealSheafData) (H : X.Modules) :
    ∃ (θ : formalCompletionSystem K H ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor I ≅
        (formalCompletionSystem I H ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor K).flip),
      ∀ e n : ℕ,
        formalModuleQuotientπ K (e + 1) H ≫
          formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) (formalModuleQuotient K (e + 1) H) ≫
          (θ.hom.app (op e)).app (op n) =
        formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) H ≫
          formalModuleQuotientπ K (e + 1) (formalModuleQuotient I (n + 1) H)
